cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You've thanked the wedding guests. What about the person who cooked?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you made the food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then why does the programme thank 'the buffet'?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The buffet would like its surname pronounced correctly.

mechanism: A claims to have trained a speaker in thanks and uses correction of that performance to secure personal recognition.
confusable: The goal is acknowledgment, not merely teaching pronunciation; A keeps pointing B toward naming A as cook and teacher.
comparison: Technical credit trade versus family speech rehearsal and name correction.
seedUse: Keep D09 unnamed buffet thank-you and surname payoff; S05 public-speaking credit makes the correction specifically pedagogical.
